sets.sample_answer: A skill I would really like to learn is playing the guitar. I have always loved music, and I think the guitar is a wonderful instrument because you can play it alone or with friends, and you can take it almost anywhere. I first became interested in it when I watched a street musician playing in my town, and I was amazed by how much joy a single instrument could bring to people passing by. I would probably learn by taking weekly lessons with a local teacher and practising for half an hour every day at home. I would also watch online tutorials to learn new songs. At first, I would expect it to be difficult, especially learning the chords, but I think regular practice would help me improve. Learning the guitar would help me relax after work and give me a creative hobby. In the long term, I hope I could play for my family and friends, and perhaps even join a small music group.

points: what you like or dislike about it

sets.sample_answer: My hometown is Urlabari, a small town in the eastern part of Nepal. It is surrounded by green hills and tea gardens, and the air is much cleaner than in the capital. The town is not very large, so most people know each other, and there is a friendly, relaxed atmosphere. Most people in Urlabari work in farming, small shops or teaching, and there is a busy market in the centre where farmers sell vegetables, fruit and spices every morning. One thing I like most about my hometown is the sense of community. People help each other, and festivals are celebrated together in the streets. On the other hand, there are not many job opportunities for young people, and the roads and internet connection could be better. Despite this, I feel very attached to Urlabari, because it is where I grew up, and I hope to return there often, even if I live elsewhere for work.

What can governments do to encourage healthier diets?
sets.sample_answer: A healthy meal I enjoy very much is a simple vegetable and lentil curry with rice, which my mother often cooks at home. It is made with lentils, spinach, carrots, tomatoes and a little garlic and ginger, and it is served with a small bowl of steamed rice and some yoghurt. The dish is prepared by boiling the lentils until they are soft, then adding the vegetables and spices and cooking everything together for about twenty minutes. It is not difficult to make, and it does not need much oil. I usually eat this meal for lunch, especially on days when I have been working at home, because it gives me energy without making me feel heavy or sleepy. I think it is healthy because lentils are rich in protein and fibre, and the vegetables provide vitamins and minerals. It is also a good example of traditional home cooking, which I believe is much healthier than fast food.

sets.sample_answer: A journey I remember well is a bus trip I took with my family to Pokhara, a beautiful city near the mountains in Nepal. We travelled by coach, and the journey took about eight hours, but the views along the way were wonderful, with green hills, rivers and small villages. I travelled with my parents and my younger brother, and we spent most of the time talking, listening to music and looking out of the window. When we arrived in Pokhara, we stayed near the lake, and the next morning we woke up early to watch the sunrise over the mountains, which was one of the most beautiful sights I have ever seen. I remember this journey so well because it was one of the few holidays we took together as a family, and because it was my first time seeing such tall mountains so close. It made me want to travel more and to explore other parts of my country.

sets.sample_answer: A book I read recently and enjoyed is a novel about a young woman who leaves her small village to study in a big city. The story follows her as she faces new challenges, makes friends, and learns to live on her own for the first time. I chose to read it because a friend recommended it, and because the main character reminded me of myself when I started university. What I enjoyed most was the way the author described everyday life in detail, so I could really imagine the busy streets, the small flat where she lived, and the people she met. The book was also very encouraging, because it showed that it is normal to feel afraid when you start something new, and that hard work and patience can help you succeed. After finishing it, I felt more confident about my own future, and I have already recommended the book to two of my friends.

sets.sample_answer: A festival I would like to describe is Dashain, the biggest festival in Nepal, which is usually celebrated in September or October. It lasts for fifteen days, and it is a time when families come together, even if they live far away. During Dashain, people clean and decorate their homes, wear new clothes, and visit their relatives. Elders put tika, a mixture of rice and red powder, on the foreheads of younger family members and give them blessings and gifts. There are also special meals, with meat, rice and sweets, and children enjoy playing on swings that are built in villages and towns. Dashain is important because it celebrates the victory of good over evil, and it gives families a chance to meet, forgive each other and start the new season with hope. For me, it is also a reminder of my childhood, when the whole family gathered at my grandparents house.

sets.sample_answer: A piece of technology I use every day is my smartphone. I use it for almost everything: checking messages, reading the news, listening to music, taking photos and studying online. I started using a smartphone about six years ago, when I began university, and since then it has become an essential part of my daily routine. In the morning, I use it to check the weather and plan my day, and in the evening I often use it to watch short lessons or to practise English. My phone has changed my life in many ways. It helps me stay in touch with friends and family who live far away, and it gives me access to information that would have been difficult to find in the past. On the other hand, I sometimes spend too much time on it, especially on social media, so I try to put it away during meals and before bed. Overall, I think it is a very useful tool, as long as it is used sensibly.

sets.sample_answer: A physical activity I enjoy very much is playing football. I have played it since I was a child, and I still play every Saturday morning with a group of friends in a field near my home. We usually play for about two hours, and afterwards we sit together and talk, which makes it a social activity as well as good exercise. I enjoy football because it is fast, exciting and a good way to keep fit. It also teaches teamwork, because you have to pass the ball, support your teammates and think quickly. Playing football helps me to relax after a busy week, and it clears my mind. Even when my team loses, I feel happier and more energetic after the game. I would like to keep playing for as long as I can, and perhaps one day I will coach children, so they can enjoy the game as much as I have.

sets.sample_answer: A job I would like to have in the future is working as a software developer. I have always been interested in computers, and I enjoy solving problems and building things that people can use. A software developer needs to understand programming languages, to think logically, and to work well in a team, because most projects involve several people. I am interested in this job because it combines creativity with logic, and because there are many opportunities to learn new tools and to work with people from different countries. To prepare for it, I am studying programming every day, building small projects, and learning how to work with other developers online. I also hope to gain experience through an internship, so I can understand how real software teams work. In the long term, I would like to work for a company that builds useful products, and perhaps one day to lead my own team.

sets.sample_answer: A natural place I like to visit is a small park near a river in my town. It is about twenty minutes walk from my home, and it is one of the few quiet places in the area. The park has tall trees, a path along the river, and several wooden benches where people can sit and relax. In the morning, many people come to walk, run or practise yoga, and in the evening families bring their children to play. I like to go there when I want to think or to escape from the noise of the town. Sitting by the river, listening to the water and watching the birds, helps me to feel calm and refreshed. I also enjoy going there with friends, especially in spring, when the trees are covered in new leaves and flowers. This park is important to me because it reminds me that nature is close by, even in a busy town, and that we should look after such places.

sets.sample_answer: A teacher who had a strong influence on me was my English teacher in secondary school, Mr Sharma. He taught us English for three years, and he was known for being both strict and kind. He expected us to work hard, but he also made his lessons interesting by telling stories, asking us questions, and encouraging us to speak English as much as possible. What made him special was that he believed in every student. When I struggled with writing, he spent extra time helping me, and he often wrote encouraging comments on my work. Because of him, I began to enjoy English, and I started reading books in English outside school. His encouragement gave me the confidence to study computer science, which is taught mainly in English, and later to prepare for this test. I will always be grateful to him, because he showed me that a good teacher can change the direction of a students life.

sets.sample_answer: A meal I enjoyed very much was a dinner I had with my family last year during a festival. We gathered at my grandparents house, and there were about fifteen of us, including cousins I had not seen for a long time. My grandmother and my aunts cooked a traditional meal of rice, lentil soup, vegetable curry, pickles and yoghurt, with sweet rice pudding for dessert. We sat together on the floor, as we always do on special occasions, and we talked, laughed and shared stories while we ate. What made the meal so enjoyable was not only the food, which was delicious, but also the feeling of being together. Everyone was relaxed, and nobody was in a hurry. I remember thinking how lucky I was to have such a close family. That evening reminded me that a meal is about more than food: it is a chance to connect with the people we love.

sets.sample_answer: A place I would like to visit in the future is Kyoto, in Japan. I have read a lot about Kyoto, and I am fascinated by its history, its temples and its beautiful gardens. The city is famous for its traditional wooden houses, its cherry blossom in spring, and its quiet shrines. If I visit, I would like to walk through the old streets in the early morning, visit the famous temples, and try traditional Japanese food. I would also like to see the bamboo forest and to take part in a tea ceremony, which is an important part of Japanese culture. I want to visit Kyoto because it seems very different from my own country, and I think travelling there would help me to understand another culture more deeply. It would also be a wonderful chance to take photographs and to experience a way of life that values calm, beauty and respect for tradition.

sets.sample_answer: An environmental problem in my country is air pollution, especially in Kathmandu, the capital. During the winter months, the air becomes thick with dust and smoke, and it is often difficult to see the mountains that surround the valley. The main causes are the large number of old vehicles on the roads, dust from construction sites, and smoke from brick factories and from burning waste. This pollution is a serious health problem, because it can cause breathing difficulties, especially for children and older people. It also damages the citys image and makes life less pleasant for everyone. To solve the problem, the government could improve public transport, so fewer people need to drive, and it could introduce stricter checks on vehicle emissions. People could also help by using cleaner fuel, planting more trees, and avoiding burning rubbish. I believe that with better planning and public awareness, the air in Kathmandu could become much cleaner in the future.

sets.sample_answer: A friend I have known for a long time is my school friend, Ramesh. We met when we were both ten years old, on our first day at secondary school, because we sat next to each other in class. Since then, we have spent a lot of time together, playing football, studying for exams, and later, when we left school, helping each other with university applications. Even though we now live in different cities, we still talk every week and meet whenever we can. What I value most about our friendship is trust. I know I can tell Ramesh anything, and he will listen without judging me, and he knows the same is true of me. He has supported me during difficult times, and he always celebrates my successes. Our friendship is important to me because it reminds me of where I came from, and because it shows that a true friend stays with you, even when life changes.
sets.topic: A friend you have known for a long time
